title: Identify a big diagonal ideal by alternating determinants

source.citation: Daniele Agostini and Jinhyung Park, Determinantal ideals of secant varieties, arXiv:2510.01895

translation.notes: The independent Oscar/Macaulay2 calculation is restated from its exponent data. Mutual Groebner reduction proves that the 22 alternating determinants generate the intersection of the three pairwise column-diagonal ideals.
